environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection via IAM database authentication. The service connects as role 'svc_readonly_0x7f' which was provisioned through a Terraform module that applies a restricted grant set. The role's effective permissions are derived from pg_default_acl entries combined with a row-level security policy on the users table. The role inherits from 'ro_base' which has SELECT on all tables but explicit REVOKE of INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on schema public from 'ro_base' CASCADE. Additionally, the RDS parameter group sets 'rds.restrict_password_commands' to 1, preventing any role below rds_superuser from executing ALTER ROLE ... PASSWORD. The net effect is that even if the application code attempts UPDATE users SET password_hash = ..., the database returns ERROR 42501 (insufficient_privilege) and the password is never changed.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO ro_base; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM ro_base CASCADE; GRANT ro_base TO svc_readonly_0x7f;
config.row_level_security: ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY readonly_users ON users FOR SELECT TO ro_base USING (true);
